subject.title: Allow before_agent_start hooks to override prompt

question: Should trusted prompt-mutating plugins be allowed to replace user input, and should that replacement affect only model-visible input or also the persisted user message?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing capability, but code cannot safely choose the plugin authority, audit semantics, and multi-plugin precedence without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded replacement API
options.body: Add replacement to before_prompt_build under allowPromptInjection, use explicit priority semantics, preserve safe audit metadata, and implement parity across Pi, CLI, and Codex.

options.title: Keep prompts additive-only
options.body: Reject direct replacement and direct context-management plugins toward a separately approved full-context transformation or context-engine API.

options.title: Allow model-only replacement
options.body: Permit replacement only for the outbound model input while retaining the original transcript, clearly documenting that this is truncation rather than durable redaction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded replacement API
recommendation.body: Add replacement to before_prompt_build under allowPromptInjection, use explicit priority semantics, preserve safe audit metadata, and implement parity across Pi, CLI, and Codex.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the strongest merged history spanning prompt-hook contracts, documentation, and Codex harness parity.
